## Summary of Changes
Please include a summary of the changes and the motivation/context for this pull request.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance / A11y optimization

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] `npm run test` passes without failures (all unit tests green)
- [ ] `npx tsc -b` passes without type errors
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds cleanly
- [ ] Tested responsive layout on mobile and desktop
- [ ] Tested reduced-motion accessibility preference
